plan.notes: Source: 'Sample Degree Plan: Bachelor of Science (BS) Biology- Cell/Molecular Biology', Bulletin Year 2022-2023 (shc.edu Program Checklists page). Sample plan; the Degree Audit in BadgerWeb is the official degree plan per the plan's own footer. Genuine catalog quirks kept verbatim: the semester 2 footer prints 'Total credit hours 16' but the header says 17 and the rows sum to 17 - recorded per the rows (17); semester 3 offers 'BIO 240/243 Anatomy and Physiology I with lab (Fall only course) -or- BIO205/207 Invertebrate zoology and lab'; semester 4 offers 'BIO 241/244 Anatomy and Physiology II with laboratory (Spring only course) -or- BIO254/256 Vertebrate zoology and lab'; THL101 prints '(or other Core)'; BIO 202 shadowing (0-1 cr) recorded at 0 (optional). Semesters 7-8 'Suggested elective' rows are choice slots against the plan's Upper BIO Electives list (minimum 16 hours, includes BIO 450 Molecular Biology). Sequenced sum 125 matches the printed 'Total Semester Hours: 125'.
